title: Clarity of Scripture
definition: The clarity of Scripture is the truth that God's Word is given so that its central message of salvation, faith, obedience, and godly living can be understood by ordinary people who read it with humility and dependence on God.
summary: Scripture is clear enough to make sinners wise for salvation and to guide God's people in truth.
christFocus: The clarity of Scripture shines most clearly in its witness to Christ, the Gospel, repentance, faith, and discipleship.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The clarity of Scripture means God has spoken to be understood. The Bible contains deep truths that require careful study, but its central message is not locked away from ordinary believers.

This does not mean every passage is equally easy or that teachers are unnecessary. Some Scriptures require patient reading, context, comparison with other passages, and faithful teaching.

God's Word gives light. The humble reader who depends on the Lord, reads in context, and seeks to obey can truly understand what God has revealed for faith and life.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people feel intimidated by the Bible and assume they cannot understand it without being an expert. The clarity of Scripture encourages believers to open the Word with confidence and humility.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture prayerfully and patiently. Do not give up because some passages are difficult. Use faithful teaching and study tools, but keep returning to the text itself.
